slides.title: Stings
body: A worker can sting many times
The sting never detaches from the worker
Smoke calms the guards before handling. It masks the scent of their alarm

slides.title: Brood chill
body: Brood chill strikes capped brood left uncovered on a cold day
Remove a chilled frame and burn it

slides.title: Brood fever
body: Brood fever strikes open brood in a hive with no shade
Fit a shade board and leave the frames in place

slides.title: Reading the bloom count
body: A bloom count below ten in high summer is the first sign of brood fever
A sudden fall in the bloom count after rain is normal

slides.title: Inspection checklist
body: 3. Look for grey or yellow brood
4. Heft the hive to judge its stores
5. Write the bloom count in the hive book
